MEAL-01.description: Personal/team meals reimbursable up to $75/attendee. Missing attendee count = missing info.

MEAL-02.description: Client entertainment over $500 requires business justification and client name.

TRAVEL-01.description: Economy flights, standard hotels, and standard/economy ground transport are eligible.

SAAS-01.description: Subscriptions are policy-eligible up to $200 / month.

HW-01.description: Hardware purchases are policy-eligible up to $1,000.

HW-02.description: Hardware over $1,000 is a Capital expense — always human-approved.
